Feature Extraction: The process of identifying and isolating relevant features from an image, often using filters or algorithms . Edge Detection: Identifying boundaries or transitions between different regions in an image. Object Detection : Identifying and localizing specific objects within an image or video frame. Segmentation : Dividing an image into meaningful segments or regions, often used for separating objects from the background .
